title: VeruSteer: Learning What to Repair Next in Verus
abstract: arXiv:2610.29755v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based verification systems repair Rust proofs by revising programs in response to Verus diagnostics. When several error types are reported, pipelines such as AutoVerus and VeruSAGE select the next repair target using a preset priority. Yet each repair changes the program and the errors that follow, so the same reported types can require different choices at different states. We present VeruSteer, which learns to select error types from the outcomes of alternative repair trajectories. It constructs repair trees offline and compares paths from the same initial program by verification success, repair rounds, and final verification progress. These comparisons supervise a selector that combines step-wise imitation with trajectory preference ranking. translated_title: VeruSteer：学习在 Verus 中接下来该修复什么
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的验证系统通过根据 Verus 的诊断信息修改程序来修复 Rust 证明。当报告了多种错误类型时，诸如 AutoVerus 和 VeruSAGE 之类的流水线会使用预设的优先级来选择下一个修复目标。然而，每次修复都会改变程序及其后续出现的错误，因此相同的已报告错误类型在不同状态下可能需要不同的选择。我们提出了 VeruSteer，它从备选修复轨迹的结果中学习如何选择错误类型。该方法离线构建修复树，并通过验证是否成功、修复轮次数以及最终验证进展来比较源自同一初始程序的不同路径。这些比较用于监督一个选择器，该选择器将逐步模仿与轨迹偏好排序相结合。该选择器对程序、验证器反馈以及先前的选择应用自注意力机制，以对当前报告的错误类型进行排序。它在单个修复轨迹中取代了默认的优先级设置。
tldr: VeruSteer 通过离线构建修复树并比较不同修复轨迹的验证结果，训练出一个结合逐步模仿与轨迹偏好排序的神经选择器，从而动态决定 Verus 证明修复中下一步应修复的错误类型，取代了传统的预设静态优先级策略。
en_tdlr: VeruSteer learns to dynamically decide which error type to repair next in Verus proof repair by constructing repair trees offline and training a selector that combines step-wise imitation with trajectory preference ranking, replacing preset static priority rules.
